# Header

Display the brand and the name of the digital service with the primary navigation. It is the most iconic UI component of the application.
See [Header guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/header/design/)

<Source code="import { Header } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

- Any other props supplied will be provided to the root elements
- For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/Header/index.ts)
- If you are using `IconButton`, then make sure to use the `ghostNegative` variant to make it visible on the darker background.<br />
- If you are using `Link`, then make sure to use the `Negative` variant to make it visible on the darker background.

### Responsive

On small screens, the tabs will automatically switch to scrollable tabs.<br />
For a better responsive experience, we recommend to replace tab navigation and actions with a Menu Button
and a <LinkTo kind="Components/SideNav" story="temporary">Side Navigation</LinkTo>.

See the <LinkTo kind="Templates/Responsive" story="open">Responsive template</LinkTo> for a full responsive implementation.
